implementation.policy: Callers may shorten inactivity, but cannot extend either guard. Inactivity resets on received nonempty byte chunks rather than total elapsed transfer time.
implementation.recovery: Retry the same URL for transient HTTP server responses, transport/read failures or inactive headers/body. No mirror or cache substitution.
implementation.integrity: Complete bytes are hashed before writing. Different attempts never share body chunks. Permanent HTTP failures, checksum mismatches and corrupt cached data remain terminal.
implementation.resources: Each retired request is aborted; readers/body streams and inactivity timers are canceled/released in cleanup.
implementation.diagnostics: Retry diagnostics retain the attempt and transport error or stalled phase/received-byte count.

checksumPerformance.rootCause: CPU profiling of the retained 5,000-tick staffing/save/replay scenario put 39.2% of self samples on its two per-character FNV multiplication lines.
checksumPerformance.correction: When a UTF-16 high byte is zero, combine both FNV rounds with the squared prime modulo 2^32. Retain the two-round path for all other code units.
checksumPerformance.format: Unchanged little-endian UTF-16 checksum bytes. No cached values, rule/profile changes, shorter replays or changed deadlines.

independentArithmetic.method: Independent integer arithmetic modulo 2^32 over every UTF-16 code unit and boundary/seeded hash states. No game timers or cached checksums.
